- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as neat, sensible, and plain.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Jane is plain, plodding, conscientious, and pragmatic. She is gamely determined and possesses unshakeable nerves that keep her calm in tough situations. Practical in her outlook, she is intrigued by high society and values material luxuries such as diamonds.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c30 P36](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0036), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c33 P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)_

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea as the daughter of Harmon Andrews. In her schooldays, she participated in local youth activities, including the Story Club and school recitations. She attended Queen's Academy alongside her friends, studying for her teacher's license and winning the honors in the domestic science course. Upon completing her studies, she became a schoolteacher at Newbridge, while also serving as a founding member and active committee chairman in the Avonlea Voluntary Improvement Society. She later went west to teach on the western prairies. Upon returning home, she became engaged to Mr. Inglis, a Winnipeg millionaire, planning a wedding tour to Europe and a life in a mansion.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v3 c2 P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 c12 P10](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0010), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027)_
